intro.title: Utility Types
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React component that displays a user profile card. You will learn how to use TypeScript utility types like `Pick` and `Omit` to create flexible and reusable type definitions. The main technologies involved are React for the UI and TypeScript for type safety. By the end, you'll understand how utility types help you manage and transform object types efficiently in your projects.
intro.usecase: Utility types are essential for managing complex data structures in real-world React applications. In e-commerce dashboards, they help create filtered views of product data without modifying the original datasets. When building user profile forms, utility types ensure type safety when extracting or omitting sensitive fields like passwords. They're also crucial in admin panels where developers need to create read-only versions of editable data models for audit logs.
